tasks.name: Frontend UI
tasks.description: Create a simple HTML page with a form to input and save notes. Display the list of saved notes fetched from the API.

tasks.name: Backend API
tasks.description: Implement backend API endpoints to handle saving and retrieving notes.

tasks.name: Database Models
tasks.description: Define the Note model and database schema to store and retrieve notes.

tasks.name: Testing
tasks.description: Write tests for the API endpoints and ensure the frontend integrates correctly with the backend.

tasks.name: Deployment
tasks.description: Set up deployment configuration for the application, including hosting and database setup.

T1.implementation_approach: Design and develop the frontend using a framework like React or Angular, ensuring responsiveness and user-friendly interfaces.
T1.notes: Focus on reusable components and consistent styling.

T2.implementation_approach: Build RESTful APIs using a backend framework like Express.js or Django to handle business logic and data processing.
T2.notes: Ensure proper authentication and error handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Define database schemas and models using an ORM like Sequelize or Mongoose to interact with the database.
T3.notes: Optimize for scalability and maintain data integrity.

T4.implementation_approach: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools like Jest or Cypress to ensure code reliability.
T4.notes: Aim for high test coverage and automate test execution.

T5.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using platforms like AWS, Heroku, or Docker, ensuring proper CI/CD pipelines are in place.
T5.notes: Monitor performance and set up error tracking post-deployment.
